newsitem.title: GREECE: Sidenor block trade at 13,000 drs.
newsitem.headline: Sidenor block trade at 13,000 drs.

text.p: A block of 400,000 shares of metallurgical firm Sidenor was placed at 13,000 drachmas with foreign and local institutions, block trade coordinator NIBID Bank, the investment arm of the National Bank of Greece, said in a statement.
The shares, now trading at 13,800 drachmas, were placed through National Securities, Alpha Brokerage, Telesis and Hermes Securities, NIBID said.
"The placement increases significantly the free float of the stock and the proceeds will be applied toward the capital increase," it said. "The rights issue will be completed by August 14."
The block trade follows the recent merger of Erlikon S.A. and Sidenor and a two-for-21 rights issue at 1,800 drachmas a share to raise 4.38 billion drachmas.
After the merger but before the rights issue the company had 5.31 million shares in issue.
NIBID has acted as advisor to the company for the merger and the rights issue, it added. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
